verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents generic trace ingestion through its own SDKs, custom code, or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle. Nothing in the evidence names a prebuilt integration for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, or any other framework. A generic OTel endpoint and raw SDK ingestion are building blocks for instrumentation, not existing framework integrations, so they earn no credit for this story.
